parsed.scene_description: A long red carpet leads toward a narrow opening in a wall. At the far end of the opening, a purple four-pointed star is visible against a dark background. The walls on either side of the carpet have a white background with blue and purple geometric patterns.

Before I get too close to the narrow gap, I should check my body's width to ensure I can fit through, but for now, moving forward is the most direct action.
